title: org.ligatureprotocol.control
description: IMPLEMENTATION ONLY, not protocol (milestone 1 decision LP-30). Messages between lpctl and ligatured over a Unix domain socket on one machine. Each frame is a 4-byte big-endian length followed by one CBOR map, at most 1 MiB. A message is a request (lpctl to daemon), a response (daemon to lpctl, exactly one per request) or an event (daemon to lpctl, zero or more before the response), told apart by its type. Decoders ignore unknown fields. Nothing here is signed or leaves the machine. The domain ligatureprotocol.org is a placeholder; it is not yet registered.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

id.description: Chosen by lpctl per request, unique on the connection. Responses and events carry the id of the request they belong to.

key.description: revoke: the binding, principal or master key to revoke. files.send, files.get: the binding key of the device to send to or fetch from.

offer.description: pair.introduce: the newcomer's offer as scanned or typed (the text behind its QR code).

introducer.description: pair.introduce: whether the newcomer becomes an introducer. Defaults to the daemon's policy.

pairing.description: pair.confirm and pair.abort: the id of the open pair.introduce or pair.join request on this connection.

name.description: init: the person's self-asserted display name (ADR 0032). Required by init.

deviceName.description: init: this device's display name; defaults to the host name (ADR 0034).

text.description: clipboard.set: the text to put on the local clipboard (diagnostics and the loopback run).

mime.description: clipboard.put: the type of the part read from paths[0]. clipboard.paste: the type to paste into paths[0], fetched if promised.

title.description: notify: the title of a test notification posted from this device to every displaying peer.

body.description: notify: the body of the test notification.

paths.description: files.send: absolute paths of the files to push. files.offer: one absolute path to offer. clipboard.put: the file whose bytes form the part. clipboard.paste: the file to write the pasted bytes to.

ids.description: files.get: the ids the peer offered. files.withdraw: the one id to withdraw.

to.description: files.get: an absolute directory or file path to land in, instead of the download folder.

transfer.description: files.cancel: the id of the transfer in flight.

ok.description: The result when the request succeeded. Its shape depends on the request: status returns at least initialised (boolean), version (string) and, once initialised, person (public key), name and deviceName; devices and caps return objects described by the daemon's documentation; init, revoke and the pairing requests return an empty map.

offer.description: pair.offer: the text lpctl renders as a QR code and prints beneath it.

code.description: pair.code: the six-digit short authentication string the user compares.

progress.description: files.progress: the transfer so far, with its id, peer, direction, each file's name, size, bytes done and state, and the outcome once it ends (the shape is the daemon's files_sync::TransferProgress).
